executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Re-run ONLY these 5 previously failed tests. DO NOT regenerate the test code — use the existing test files. CRITICAL RULES: 1) Use UUID NOT timestamps for ALL unique values. 2) Every test MUST start with FRESH SIGNUP at /auth/signup. 3) TC008 (Add RTF): Select timezone FIRST from dropdown, then times, then Submit. 4) TC009 (Change Password): After success, toast 'Password changed successfully!' appears, then user is LOGGED OUT and redirected to /auth/login. Fields cleared via formik.resetForm(). 5) TC010 (Delete RTF): Fresh signup, create app, add RTF, then delete it. 6) TC012 (Toggle Theme): Theme toggle is a button/icon in the top navigation bar.
